purpose: Determine from the exact sealed V9 execution traces whether current-node frontier targets end in a matching verified departure, a departure through another exit stub, or a loop merge back to the same node, without evaluator ground truth.

approval.scope: One immutable read-only audit of all 30 V9 traces and snapshots in the exact finalized 90-case source; no simulation, bag read, training, model selection, threshold tuning or source mutation.
approval.confirmation_reference: Standing user authorization for autonomous execution within the fixed paper scope; execution remains conditional on exact finalized source state, schedule and seal binding.

sampling.independent_analysis_unit: one V9 closed-loop case within the frozen world-by-environment-seed block design

method.event_identity: For every graph event, bind the immediately preceding persistent current-node frontier identity and compare it with the exact stub the graph would consume for the verified source-to-destination traversal; preserve same-node loop merges separately.
method.persistence: Report contiguous target frames and route-arc distance before every event. Aggregate only against each case's already frozen waypoint lookahead and minimum graph-event travel; introduce no new selected threshold.

failure_policy: Fail on source state/status/count/seal/schedule drift, any missing or unsealed trace/snapshot, invalid graph identity, non-contiguous frame, non-monotone route arc, missing frozen planner distance, source write, bag read, training, C09/C10 read or threshold selection.
expected_evidence: 90-case source provenance and manifest with 60 verified V9 trace/snapshot hashes
30 per-case frontier-attempt outcome audits with target persistence distance
aggregate matched/divergent/same-node counts and counts reaching the two already frozen planner distance scales

estimated_cost.compute: Read-only CPU JSON audit; zero Gazebo, ROS, GPU, training or raw bag decompression.
